title: Staged Fixed Point Topic Catalog

Staged Fixed Point Topic Catalog

Canonical folder topic: fixed_point

Subtopics

  • fixed_point.brouwer - Brouwer-style fixed point targets and simplex routes.
  • fixed_point.kakutani - Kakutani statements and reductions from Nash existence.
  • fixed_point.sperner - Sperner and combinatorial fixed-point infrastructure.

Boundary

Put general convexity or linear algebra facts under their own support topics.
